power.method: 12 VDC or 24 VAC; 360 mA at 12 VDC (700 mA with heater on), 330 mA at 24 VAC (650 mA with heater on)

features: WDR dual shutter, 94 dB dynamic range (XF-Dynamic, HDR, Smart BLC)
True day/night with switchable IR filter
Bilinx bidirectional coaxial control (remote setup, firmware update)
Cable compensation up to 1000 m coax
SensUp up to 10x, 2D/3D dynamic noise reduction
Manual varifocal lens, automatic iris, 3-axis adjustment
IP66 / NEMA 4X, IEC 60068-2-75 50 J (exceeding IK10) vandal-resistant housing
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (VDN_5085_Data_sheet_enUS_10390479883.pdf, V7 Apr 2014). 9-22 mm lens model. Suffix meanings: -Vx1x = PAL/50 Hz, -Vx2x = NTSC/60 Hz; trailing S = surface-mount version (ordering text adds "surface mount"). Sensitivity values are the 30 IRE figures for this lens with SensUp off (SensUp 10x lowers them 10x). Operating temperature -30 to 55 C with heater off, -50 to 55 C with heater on. Effective pixels 976x494 on NTSC models.
